query: UPDATE privacy.read_count c SET alerted = true WHERE c.hour = $1 AND NOT c.alerted AND c.reads > $2::float8 * greatest($3::float8, (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.reads), 0) FROM privacy.read_count p WHERE p.action = c.action AND p.hour >= $1 - interval '14 days' AND p.hour < $1) / $4::float8) RETURNING c.id
